SFORS trades in the global financial markets and are among the key proprietary trading players and pre-market trading leaders.

We are looking for a Research Analyst to join our Trading Research & Development team and cover research and quantitative processes within the department.

What you will do

  • Monitor the market.

Track key news, earnings reports, macroeconomic and geopolitical events, with a focus on the US market.

  • Separate signal from noise.

Understand which events genuinely impact companies, sectors, and the broader market.

  • Identify connections and patterns.

Spot recurring themes, sector rotations, shifts in market narratives, and market reactions.

Document important events and market reactions, compare new cases with historical ones, and build a structured knowledge base.

Prepare internal market reviews and lectures, and explain key events and trends to the team.

  • Develop analytical processes.

Look for new sources, formats, and ways to find and communicate important information faster and more efficiently.

We are looking for a creative, hands-on, and detail-oriented Junior Event Specialist who genuinely enjoys making spaces and events look beautiful.

Event Support & Coordination

  • Support the organisation and execution of internal corporate events and employee engagement activities.

  • Assist with event preparation, setup, logistics, and on-site coordination.

  • Help source decorations, flowers, gifts, materials, and other event-related items.

  • Coordinate with local suppliers, florists, decorators, venues, and other service providers when required.

  • Support larger events together with the Event Manager / wider team.

Event Decoration & Styling

  • Take ownership of decoration and visual setup for small and regular internal events.

  • Create simple decoration concepts based on the event theme, occasion, and company style.

  • Arrange flowers, table decorations, balloons, props, signage, and other decorative elements.

  • Prepare and decorate office spaces for holidays, celebrations, team activities, and other internal events.

  • Ensure event spaces look polished, welcoming, and visually consistent.

We are currently looking for a Network Administrator to join our team in Dubai and support the day-to-day operation, monitoring, and development of our network infrastructure.


Responsibilities:

  • Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot network infrastructure (MikroTik RouterOS, Fortinet FortiOS) in line with approved architecture standards.

  • Manage Fortinet and MikroTik firewall rules, NAT, VLAN segmentation, and security zones (physical security networks, management, and user segments).

  • Support High Availability (HA) mechanisms (MLAG, VRRP, FortiGate HA) and monitor link redundancy to ensure continuous uptime.

  • Conduct regular network surveys, health checks, and audits to provide recommendations for infrastructure improvements and modernization.

  • Maintain and tune network monitoring, logging, and alerting systems (Zabbix, Grafana, ELK).

  • Configure and support centralized user authentication and access control for network infrastructure (RADIUS, LDAP).

  • Resolve network incidents, perform Root Cause Analysis (RCA), and keep operational documentation and network diagrams up to date.

  • Excellent interviewing and candidate assessment skills.

  • A proactive, well-organised, and solution-oriented mindset.

  • The ability to manage multiple recruitment processes while maintaining a high-quality candidate experience.

We are looking for ambitious, analytically minded, and technologically proficient candidates to join an internship program focused on trading and investment research. This is a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience in the dynamic world of financial trading.

During the six-month internship, you will receive training from industry experts, learn how to analyze market data, and develop trading strategies. Successful completion of the internship may lead to an opportunity to join our team.

Our Ideal Candidates:

  • Ambitious: motivated to achieve meaningful results in a highly competitive environment.

  • Experienced in working with information: able to research, analyze, and structure information for decision-making.

  • Critical thinkers: capable of making independent decisions based on deep analysis, knowledge, and experience.

  • STEM-oriented candidates are a strong advantage: talent and interest in technical sciences, economics, and finance.

Who Should Apply:
This internship is designed for recent graduates or final-year students who are passionate about finance and the world of trading. We welcome candidates from diverse academic backgrounds, especially those with a strong inclination toward STEM disciplines.
